dependencies: Real VC5 single-threaded CRT __ftol via C __int64 conversion; source FP control and round_float
Real BHWorldGeometry bounds and ordered explicit registry, source entity pool/player identities
Borrowed writable packet buffers, accepted/rejected counters and stable lifetimes; no guessed original globals/vtables
contracts: 004234d0 actually takes owner pointer plus point and returns EAX boolean; decompiler false uint64 return/one-arg signature discarded. 8 bytes: ushort world index then 3 quantized positions.

Position t=(point-min)/(max-min) remains PC53; unordered/below -.5 -> -.5, >=1.5 -> binary32 1.49; ushort trunc(16384+32768*t). Decoder t=(ushort-16384)/32768 and max*t+min*(1-t), one float output store per axis.
00423660 actual cdecl vector pointer/float scale; retained divisor scale/128; __ftol signed 64-bit, signed low EAX saturates to [-128,127]. Zero scale uses real masked CRT conversion.
Checksum header word XOR ceil(payload/4) padded payload words; padding overwritten before validation. Logical length 8+byte count, padded scratch end differs from sent wire length.

Receive accepted increments before checksum; bad checksum rolls increment back and increments rejected. Invalid world/nonlocal player index consumes ushort and decrements accepted/increments rejected. Absent remote returns miss without statistics change.
Player lookup compares zero-extended wire ushort with full 32-bit local ID first. Matching local NULL pointer is success. Remote IDs limited to eight slots.
source_adapters: bh_packet_begin/append/finish: bounded buffer framing/checksum prefix. No transport substitute.
bh_packet_read_position: bridge to already-admitted bh_position_read; no duplicate recovery count.
limits: No network sends, sessions or original-code execution. Actual DirectPlay transport 00476d50, full sender 00423710, packet dispatchers and full physics owner remain unrecovered.
Source buffer begin/append/finish are explicit adapters, not admission of the transport-owning sender; globals become borrowed reader/writer/stats/world/player bindings.
Source guards reject truncation, invalid bindings, insufficient writable padding and payload >255. Valid original packet arithmetic, cursor consumption and counters retained.
PC53 finite moderate source inputs, with original masked zero extents/scale conversions specifically checked. FP exception/status-word equivalence and broad exceptional-input fidelity unvalidated.
Tests use independent wire bytes, exact dyadic lattice and analytic error bounds; no captured live network exchange or original differential execution. Saved M3 normal is an output-contract fixture.
